productionMode: one assembled RexPrompt recipe equals one finished portrait comic page
visualAuthority: approved current-production visual anchors until released StarSplitterVisions canon exists

issue1.pageRule: One scene recipe produces one page. Do not combine multiple recipes into a contact sheet, montage, issue summary, spread, cover, or single composite image.
issue1.continuityRule: Use continuityFrom plus character visual anchors and the last successful page. Failed, rejected, repeated, or superseded generations do not advance production.
issue1.letteringRule: Dialogue emitted by the assembler is exact production text. Do not invent, paraphrase, omit, duplicate, or reassign it.
issue1.pageDesignRule: Use each recipe's panelPlan as page architecture. Layout may vary, but all specified beats, cast, dialogue and final-page function must remain clear.
issue1.visualRule: Strong subject/background value separation. Readability first, scale second, spectacle third. Avoid generic beige, muddy neutrals and uncontrolled glow/debris.
issue1.frontierRule: Resolve the next unresolved page from successful current-chat production, released Visions canon when available, and ordered assembled recipes. Never store or guess a cursor.
